name: FICTIONAL Book Club
purpose: A small private page for a book club of about ten friends that shows who is in the club, which book is next and who is coming, and emails each member a reminder of the next meeting once a month.

collects.what: Each member's first name, entered by the organizer.
collects.why: To show the other members who is in the club and who is coming, and to greet the member in the reminder email.
collects.kept: While the person is a member. It is deleted when they delete their data, or when the organizer removes them from the club.

collects.what: Each member's email address, entered by the organizer.
collects.why: To send the member the monthly reminder of the next meeting, with their private link. It is never shown to other members.
collects.kept: While the person is a member. It is deleted when they delete their data, or when the organizer removes them from the club.

collects.what: The meetings each member said they would come to. Only a yes is kept; saying no removes the answer. No time of answering is kept.
collects.why: To show the members who is coming to the next meeting.
collects.kept: Until 12 months after the meeting, when the monthly reminder run deletes it, or sooner if the member deletes their data.

collects.what: A random key in each member's private link.
collects.why: So each member can open the club page, answer, download their data or delete it, without a password.
collects.kept: While the person is a member. It is deleted with the rest of their data.

sharedWith.what: Each member's first name and email address, their private link, and the next meeting's date, time, place and book, in the monthly reminder email.
sharedWith.why: To deliver the monthly reminder email.

sharedWith.who: A hosting provider, not chosen yet
sharedWith.what: Everything listed in data.collects, because the database file would be stored on its servers, and visitors' IP addresses in its own logs.
sharedWith.why: To run the page and store the database. Hosting isn't decided; the provider will be named here before the app runs there.

data.export: A member opens the private link from their reminder email and chooses Download my data: a JSON file with their first name, email address, private link and the meetings they said they would come to.
data.delete: A member opens their private link and chooses Delete my data, which deletes their name, email address, link and answers at once. The organizer can also remove a member with npm run admin -- remove <id>.
